purpose: Phase-8A resistance prediction records. Prediction is enabled ONLY as an evidence-aware mechanistic fallback (relative tendencies + expected direction), NEVER as Phase-8C forecasting. Each record documents the assumptions required to RUN Phase 8A - it never fabricates mutation identity, resistance probability, resistant-cell count, time-to-resistance, fold-resistance, or IC50 shift. Allowed labels are enumerated in prediction_labels.

pred_re_b16bl6.source_context: general tumour drug-resistance biology + verified B16BL6 tripterine-NLC treatment context (Chen 2012, response only)
pred_re_b16bl6.mechanistic_basis: Sustained effective treatment pressure on a heterogeneous melanoma population can enrich reversible drug-tolerant / adaptively resistant survivors; persistence requires additional temporal criteria. Applied predictively; no direct resistance dataset.
assumptions: resistance is time-dependent, not a binary flag
selection redistributes fractions without inventing mechanisms
pred_re_b16bl6.expected_direction: resistant/tolerant fraction may rise under sustained pressure and partially reverse on washout; treatment-sensitivity modifier decreases then partially recovers
pred_re_b16bl6.predicted_state: reversible tolerance/adaptive tendency; acquired resistance only under met persistence criteria
pred_re_b16bl6.uncertainty: Relative tendencies + direction only; all quantities NOT_REPORTED.
pred_re_b16bl6.falsifiability_statement: A longitudinal B16BL6 tripterine-NLC study showing NO tolerance/adaptive enrichment under sustained effective exposure, or fully irreversible resistance after a single exposure, would contradict this prediction.
pred_re_b16bl6.limitations: Not a measured resistance trajectory; schematic ordinal + normalized only.

pred_re_human.source_context: general tumour drug-resistance biology (human skin melanoma, exploratory)
pred_re_human.species_transfer: none (human context defined with own distinct values, not transferred from mouse)
pred_re_human.mechanistic_basis: Human skin melanoma is predicted to show heterogeneous baseline sensitivity and reversible adaptive tendencies; exploratory only.
assumptions: own distinct values (not copied from mouse)
not validated for human clinical response
pred_re_human.expected_direction: qualitatively similar reversible tendencies to mouse but with independent values and higher uncertainty
pred_re_human.uncertainty: Entirely predictive; all quantities NOT_REPORTED; not shown by default.
pred_re_human.falsifiability_statement: Any validated human dataset contradicting reversible adaptive tendency for this context would falsify this exploratory prediction.
pred_re_human.limitations: Exploratory; mandated non-clinical warning; not shown by default.

pred_re_immune_unavailable.mechanistic_basis: Immune-associated resistance would consume immutable Phase-7C outputs; Phase 7C does not exist in this build.
pred_re_immune_unavailable.uncertainty: Immune contribution cannot be evaluated without Phase 7C.
pred_re_immune_unavailable.limitations: Blocked on Phase 7C; contributes zero to resistance burden and is labelled UNAVAILABLE (not a predicted/measured zero).

policy.no_forecasting: These records describe assumptions required to run Phase 8A; they are NOT Phase-8C prospective forecasting, probability, or ranking.
policy.never_fabricate: No mutation identity/frequency, resistance probability, resistant-cell count, time-to-resistance, fold-resistance, IC50 shift, clinical progression, or treatment failure is produced.
policy.prediction_distinguishable: Every predicted mechanism is programmatically distinguishable from an evidence-supported one (there are none here) via its prediction label.
